package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiagnosticBootstrapBindingProvisionIsSerializedAppendOnlyAndLatestOnly(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("diagnostic_bootstrap_binding_provision.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"LOCK TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE",
		"ORDER BY binding_revision DESC LIMIT 1",
		"INSERT INTO diagnostic_bootstrap_binding",
		"stored != wanted",
		"domain.ErrConflict",
		"defer tx.Rollback(ctx)",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("binding provisioner must contain %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"UPDATE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding", "DELETE FROM diagnostic_bootstrap_binding"} {
		if strings.Contains(source, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("binding provisioner must remain append-only: %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestMigrationImageUsesOnlySortedForwardMigrationsAndValidatesFreshBindingState(t *testing.T) {
	script, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../scripts/migrate-up.sh")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	contents := string(script)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"set -eu",
		"-name '*.up.sql'",
		"LC_ALL=C sort",
		"ON_ERROR_STOP=1",
		"schema_postcondition",
		"diagnostic_bootstrap_binding_rows",
		"fixture_or_binding_seeded\\\":false",
		"historical_catalog_migrations_applied\\\":true",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(contents, required) {
			t.Fatalf("migration runner must contain %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"*.down.sql", "|| true", "INSERT INTO diagnostic_bootstrap_binding"} {
		if strings.Contains(contents, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("migration runner must not contain %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
	dockerfile, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../docker/Dockerfile")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"FROM postgres:16-alpine AS migration", "ENTRYPOINT [\"/app/migrate-up\"]", "AS diagnostic-binding-provision", "AS runtime"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(dockerfile), required) {
			t.Fatalf("Dockerfile must contain %q", required)
		}
	}
}

func TestMigrationImageRunnerRejectsMissingDatabaseURLWithSafeJSON(t *testing.T) {
	command := exec.Command("sh", "../../../../scripts/migrate-up.sh")
	command.Env = []string{}
	output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("migration runner must reject a missing DATABASE_URL")
	}
	if string(output) != "{\"schema\":\"learning-planner-migration.v1\",\"status\":\"failed\",\"reason\":\"database_url_missing\"}\n" {
		t.Fatalf("migration runner emitted unsafe failure output: %q", output)
	}
}
